rationale: The assistant reached the correct fix: lift the drain hose into a high loop after the customer reported it lies flat on the cupboard floor. The first reply was long and US-centric (air gap, garbage disposal, faucet) and never asked whether the water appears after the sink is drained. The second reply was confident and correct, but it kept the US framing and told the customer to run an empty cycle to check the fix. No parts were recommended and no escalation was needed.
